verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly as a banner: striped panel with the badge and the shoebox on the left, then the headline with the body copy under it, and the CTA on the far right. The headline leads clearly. Its flaws are small: the body line is tiny at 90px tall, and the badge sits close to the box. B clips the pink '48H ONLY' badge against the left canvas edge. The shoebox straddles the stripe/lime boundary awkwardly, and the striped panel is squeezed to a sliver. The small body copy sits stacked above the CTA in a cramped right column, so the right side looks crowded while the middle is padded.
